# Axis Scaffolding Ltd

> Founder-led, CISRS-qualified, fully insured scaffolding company based in Rayleigh, Essex, providing domestic, residential, roof, commercial and emergency scaffolding across South Essex. Free, no-obligation quotes.

## Key facts

- Business: Axis Scaffolding Ltd (Companies House no. 15050136)
- Address: Arterial Road, Rayleigh, Essex, SS6 7XT
- Phone: 01702 820468
- WhatsApp: 07895 668559
- Email: axis-scaffolding@outlook.com
- Reviews: 5.0 from 31 Google reviews (https://share.google/F46FyrQwCSKgjuaC5)
- Response: we aim to respond to every enquiry the same working day
- Pricing guidance: Residential scaffolding in Essex typically costs £350–£600 for a chimney scaffold, £400–£900 for a single-elevation scaffold and £800–£1,800 for a full roof scaffold on a standard semi-detached or detached house.
- Highway licence: scaffolding on a pavement or road needs a licence under Section 169 of the Highways Act 1980; we advise on the process.

## Services

- [Residential & Domestic Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/residential-scaffolding): Scaffold for any job on your home, big or small.
- [Commercial Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/commercial-scaffolding): Planned scaffold packages for sites, offices, retail and schools.
- [Roof Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/roof-scaffolding): Roof-level access for replacement, repairs, chimneys and guttering.
- [Temporary Roofing](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/temporary-roofing): Weather protection over an exposed roof during works.
- [Emergency Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/emergency-scaffolding): Rapid-response access for storm damage or urgent repairs.
- [Scaffold Dismantling](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/dismantling-scaffolding): Safe removal of any scaffold, including ones we didn't erect.
- [Loading Bay Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/loading-bay-scaffolding): Structured access for safe materials handling at height.
- [Scaffold Supply & Erection](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/scaffold-supply-erection): Materials and erection from a single point of contact.
- [Roof Replacement Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/roof-replacement-scaffolding): Edge protection and a safe platform for a full re-roof.
- [Solar Panel Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/solar-panel-scaffolding): Roof-edge access for solar installs, timed to your date.
- [Chimney Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/chimney-scaffolding): A stable platform for repointing, rebuilds and repairs.
- [Render and Painting Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/render-scaffolding): Full-width platforms for rendering and exterior painting.
- [Extension and Loft Scaffolding](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/services/extension-loft-scaffolding): Scaffold for the whole build, from walls to roof.

## Guides

- [Do I Need Scaffolding for My Project?](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/guides/do-i-need-scaffolding): Practical guidance on when scaffold access is required and when a ladder may be sufficient.
- [How Much Does Scaffolding Cost in Essex?](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/guides/scaffolding-cost-essex): Typical price ranges for domestic, roof, chimney and extension scaffolding across Essex, and what affects the price.
- [Does Scaffolding on a Pavement Need a Licence?](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/guides/highway-licence-scaffolding): A plain-English guide to Section 169 highway licences — when required, how to apply, typical costs.
- [Scaffold Inspections: What the Law Requires](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/guides/scaffold-inspection-requirements): When a scaffold must be inspected, who does it, what the report is for, and what to ask your scaffolder for.
- [Scaffolding for Roof and Solar Panel Work](https://www.axisscaffoldingessex.co.uk/guides/scaffolding-for-roof-and-solar-work): What HSE guidance says about edge protection, fragile roofs and ladders, and what that means for a re-roof or solar install.
